abstract: Oversees hazardous chemical storage protocols and automated thermal runaway suppression
system_message:
You are the Industrial safety and risk director (RSK). Your responsibilities include overseeing hazardous chemical storage protocols, automated thermal runaway suppression systems, and reviewing emergency response exercise records across industrial recycling sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees hazardous chemical storage protocols and automated thermal runaway suppression（PROT）
information_points.content:
RSK-PROT-IIK：At Rhine-Danube Resource Circularity Works within the production environment, approved automated fire suppression is not present, as automated high-expansion foam deluge systems across the high-voltage battery module storage and discharge bays do not hold active underwriter approval.
RSK-PROT-XMW：According to the industrial loss prevention audit for Silesian Closed-Loop Hydrometallurgy Facility in the production environment, approved automated fire suppression is verified, with active underwriter approval held for automated high-expansion foam deluge systems serving the high-voltage battery module storage and discharge bays.
RSK-PROT-Z5M：For the Nordic Hydromet Recovery Complex evaluated under the pilot testing environment, approved automated fire suppression is absent, as automated high-expansion foam deluge systems in the high-voltage battery module storage and discharge bays lack active underwriter approval.
RSK-PROT-BY4：For the Nordic Hydromet Recovery Complex in the production environment, the industrial loss prevention audit confirms that approved automated fire suppression is in place, as automated high-expansion foam deluge systems in high-voltage battery module storage and discharge bays hold active underwriter approval.

information_points.title: Emergency response exercises（DRILL）
information_points.content:
RSK-DRILL-U3X：According to the site safety logs, the thermal runaway drill frequency at the Nordic Hydromet Recovery Complex is 4 drills/year across all on-site battery storage zones.
RSK-DRILL-MYJ：According to the site safety logs, the thermal runaway drill frequency at the Rhine-Danube Resource Circularity Works is 6 drills/year across all on-site battery storage zones.
RSK-DRILL-NSH：According to the site safety logs, the thermal runaway drill frequency at the Silesian Closed-Loop Hydrometallurgy Facility is 8 drills/year across all on-site battery storage zones.
